interactivity.midnightconfig.title: Interactivity
interactivity.midnightconfig.isClientSid: If client were started with client-side prediction disabled and you want to enable it, you should restart the game.
interactivity.midnightconfig.maxCoresAmo: The maximum number of CPU cores to use for physics simulation per world. If more than available cores, uses all available cores. Default to maximum available cores.
interactivity.midnightconfig.networkTran: Priorities for default networking transports. If you want to disable other transports, set their priority to -1.
interactivity.midnightconfig.udpPort.too:
-1 — Use Minecraft server port
0 — Disable UDP transport
interactivity.midnightconfig.renderSampl: How the pose of a body between two server updates is chosen. Interpolation is always slightly behind, extrapolation continues the movement when an update is late.
interactivity.midnightconfig.interpolati: How many physics ticks bodies are shown behind the newest server update. Raise it if bodies stutter.
interactivity.midnightconfig.cullingInfl: Bodies are hidden when their bounding box, grown by this much, is outside of the screen.
interactivity.midnightconfig.uselessDevO: This option does nothing useful: turn it on and try to find out what it does!
